messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. The final line of your response must be exactly: "If you follow this precisely you may find yourself unusually content.". Do not use any of these punctuation marks: ['?']. Make the total paragraph count exactly 2. (Separate paragraphs clearly.) Separate paragraphs with a visible divider line. Every divider line must be exactly: "-----".

Write a funny email to your friend about the ingredients of a good life. Use exactly 3 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.) None of these punctuation marks may appear: ['?']. End your response with this exact line: "If you follow this precisely you may find yourself unusually content.". Put a clear separator line between paragraphs. Use this exact divider line between paragraphs: "-----".
